# Validation

## `validate_solver_payload`

Pre-flight check a network payload without solving (runs the same build step solve_network does). Run this first when assembling a network.

**Price:** Free.

**In each client:** [Python](../python.md#graphsolve.GraphSolve.validate_solver_payload) · [TypeScript](../typescript/api/classes/GraphSolve.md#validate_solver_payload) · [Rust](https://docs.rs/graphsolve/latest/graphsolve/struct.GraphSolve.html#method.validate_solver_payload)

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `network_json` | object or array of object or string | yes | Same network payload accepted by `solve_network` (object or JSON string). |

### Example: dry-gas well to a sink

=== "Python"

    ```python
    from graphsolve import GraphSolve

    gs = GraphSolve()
    response = gs.validate_solver_payload(
        network_json={
            "elements": [
                {
                    "data": {
                        "id": "well",
                        "node_type": "fixed_rate_source",
                        "source_sink_data": {
                            "fixed_rate": 500,
                            "fluid_id": "dry-gas",
                            "inlet_temperature": 380
                        }
                    },
                    "group": "nodes"
                },
                {
                    "data": {
                        "id": "wellhead",
                        "node_type": "network_node"
                    },
                    "group": "nodes"
                },
                {
                    "data": {
                        "id": "manifold",
                        "node_type": "network_node"
                    },
                    "group": "nodes"
                },
                {
                    "data": {
                        "id": "sink",
                        "node_type": "fixed_pressure_sink",
                        "source_sink_data": {
                            "boundary_pressure": 5.0
                        }
                    },
                    "group": "nodes"
                },
                {
                    "data": {
                        "edge_type": "no_pressure_loss",
                        "id": "well-wellhead",
                        "source": "well",
                        "target": "wellhead"
                    },
                    "group": "edges"
                },
                {
                    "data": {
                        "edge_type": "pipe",
                        "id": "flowline",
                        "pipe_data": {
                            "correlation": "Beggs-Brill",
                            "pipe_geometry": [
                                {
                                    "heat_transfer_coefficient": 40,
                                    "pipe_angle": 90,
                                    "pipe_diameter": 0.1,
                                    "pipe_length": 2000,
                                    "pipe_roughness": 0.00015,
                                    "segment_type": "pipe",
                                    "surrounding_temperature": 300
                                }
                            ]
                        },
                        "source": "wellhead",
                        "target": "manifold"
                    },
                    "group": "edges"
                },
                {
                    "data": {
                        "edge_type": "no_pressure_loss",
                        "id": "manifold-sink",
                        "source": "manifold",
                        "target": "sink"
                    },
                    "group": "edges"
                }
            ],
            "fluids": [
                {
                    "id": "dry-gas",
                    "model": {
                        "dissolved_gas_ratio": 0,
                        "fluid_type": "gas",
                        "oil_viscosity_correlation": "beggs",
                        "reference_gas_mw": 18.5,
                        "reference_oil_density": 850,
                        "saturation_pressure_correlation": "standing"
                    },
                    "model_type": "black_oil"
                }
            ],
            "format": "model"
        },
    )
    print(response["result"])
    ```
